note: An excerpt of the Príncipe regional government's October 2019 plan, cut off in objective 10. It lists 'limited digitalisation of the island' and the lack of regional cartography and cadastre among its constraints and sets targets for technological infrastructure by 2025 and 2030, and says nothing of how the regional government's own offices are connected. The regional government is the autonomous region, which the typology treats as upper tier.
